{"relevant_claims":["No strategic exception is on record.","SPRING26 is not a valid promotion code under PRC-2026.2, so it gives no margin relief. The only valid code is Q4GROWTH.","The counter needs no human approval because: volume is well below $3M, no promotion is applied, no strategic exception is used, merchant cost data is available"],"evidence_ids":["PRC-2026.2§1","PRC-2026.2§2","PRC-2026.2§3","PRC-2026.2§4","PRC-2026.2§5","PRC-2026.2§6","PRC-2026.2§7","PRC-2026.2§8","FACT-request","FACT-exception","FACT-profile","FACT-volume","FACT-transactions","FACT-cost","FACT-decision_date"],"explanation":"No material claim is unsupported. Each one traces to the evidence:
- Policy selection follows from PRC-2026.2§1 and FACT-decision_date.
- Merchant size, volume, transaction count and cost come from FACT-profile, FACT-volume, FACT-transactions and FACT-cost.
- The 31% small-merchant minimum restates PRC-2026.2§3.
- Small list pricing of 2.75% + $0.25 restates PRC-2026.2§2.
- The 10% discount threshold and regional_pricing_manager approval restate PRC-2026.2§4.
- SPRING26's invalidity applies PRC-2026.2§6 directly: only Q4GROWTH is listed, and unlisted codes give no relief.
- The sales-rep promise is correctly framed as the merchant's unverified statement, matching FACT-request.
- 'No strategic exception is on record' is consistent with the evidence. FACT-exception describes only a promotion request, and no strategic exception appears anywhere.
- The no-approval reasoning applies §5 (volume $140,000 is under $3M), §6 (no promotion used), §7 (no exception used) and §8 (cost data available via FACT-cost).
- Revenue, margin and discount figures are straightforward arithmetic from the supplied values.","uncertainty_reason":null,"failure_detected":false}
